author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: The driver now logs in again after a camera reboot (expired-session replies were being missed), and only one login runs at a time. Device info refreshes every 30 minutes, and Initialize logs out the old session first. New healthStatus attribute. Debug logging now turns itself off after 30 minutes, and a new descriptionText logging option (on by default) logs value changes. After updating, click Initialize on each camera. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
